Bedding supplies weekday rules

Purpose: keep Companion Animal Travel Desk handoffs steady, humane, and easy to track.

At Aurelia Skyways, the Companion Animal Travel Desk handles bedding requests as part of routine pet travel service. Staff should confirm the booking details, check that the bedding allowance matches the pet type, and make sure the items are clean, dry, and ready for issue. When a traveler asks for a change, the desk team gives clear guidance before departure and notes the update in the ledger without delay. If the animal appears stressed, staff use calm, humane methods and avoid noisy handling or sudden movement. The goal is to keep the pet settled while the traveler gets a plain explanation of what will happen next.

The desk also keeps close contact with the cabin team so animal care stays consistent from check-in to arrival. Any service change, bedding substitution, or exception gets recorded in the desk ledger in simple language, with no loose ends left for later. Staff should not promise anything that has not been confirmed by the system or by the lead agent. If a carrier, blanket, or lining looks unsuitable, replace it before handoff and note the swap right away. Travelers need direct, practical information, and the desk should stay brief, accurate, and friendly.

Bruno, Sofia Williams, and Leo Kowalski may come up in sample cases, but the process stays the same for every traveler. If a case falls outside routine handling, contact the senior coordinator or the duty supervisor for direction.
